title: SG/Send: the append service caches a vault's lane configuration per server instance and never refreshes it, so after `configure` some instances answer 404 for the new lanes until they are recycled
note: Service__Vault__Append._load_append_config (sgraph_ai_app_send/lambda__user/service/Service__Vault__Append.py, _config_cache, never invalidated). Measured on 84wr8mib, 27 October: 12 concurrent writes to a lane configured minutes before, 4 accepted and 8 refused (404); 20 minutes later 7 of 8 accepted. For the conductor to carry to SG/Send. Suggested fix: a short TTL on the cache, or read config.json on every write (one small read).
